description: Open the Get Quote form for the Singapore Buying Desk (Connective Labs Pte. Ltd.): the buyer lists the office, IT or event print items they need, sees instant all-in SGD prices, and sends the list for a firm quote. ChatGPT calls this from the Get Quote button with the business_id from the business feed (connective-labs-sg-buying-desk). Opening the form changes nothing; submitting it calls request_quote. Returns business_id_recognized (whether business_id matched this desk), the business details (legal name, UEN, support email, payment terms, guarantee), the prefill values applied to the form, the categories it quotes with links, and the how_it_works steps. Example input: {"business_id":"connective-labs-sg-buying-desk"}.

business_id.description: provider_business_id from the business feed. This desk: connective-labs-sg-buying-desk.

delivery_area.description: Delivery address or area in Singapore, filled into the form's delivery field. Prices already include Singapore delivery. If left out, that field starts empty.

items.description: Optional: lines to prefill in the form.

anyOf.description: One line in the buyer's words, quantity included, e.g. '3 x HDMI cable 5m', 'microSD 128GB x10', '2 pcs HP 206A cyan toner'.

category.description: Optional: a supplies category (cable, adapter, usb-hub, memory-card, flash-drive, ssd, hdd, card-reader, ...) or an event print category (name-cards, lanyards, roll-up-banners, tote-bags).

item.description: The buyer's own wording for this line.

model.description: Model number or cartridge code exactly as printed.

quantity.description: How many units of this line item the buyer needs.

specs.description: Technical details that pin down the exact product, such as connector types, cable length, storage capacity or screen size. Uses the same fields as quote_office_supplies specs: connectors, length, capacity, card_type, va_rating, colour, ports, screen_size, wireless, interface.

needed_by.description: The date the buyer needs the items by, filled into the form's deadline field. If left out, that field starts empty.

name: request_service
